3. Gemini 2.5 Pro final benchmark, fixed threshold 0.3
Dataset: Gemini 2.5 Pro-labeled frozen set, n = 784 perfumes. Threshold: fixed 0.3. The mean in Section 1 is the average of these five Macro-F1 rows.

4. Gemini Flash threshold sweep, same 5 models
The Section 1 Flash value uses the 0.3 column averaged over these five rows. Logistic Regression performs best for Gemini Flash at threshold 0.5. XGBoost performs best
at threshold 0.3 among the tree models. Threshold 0.7 strongly reduces macro-F1, especially for BERT and BiLSTM.
